pages.text: Every animal is $(thing)male or female$(). Males show it: bulls have a nose ring and heavy horns, rams curled horns, boars tusks, roosters a tall comb and a tail plume. Jade and /tilth animal tell you too.
Only a $(thing)male and a female$() will breed, and both must be in good condition. $(thing)Sheep and goats$() only come into season in autumn, from September to December.

Mammals carry their young before giving birth: about $(thing)four days$() for mares, $(thing)three$() for cows and $(thing)two$() for ewes, nannies and sows. Sows have litters of two to four; ewes and nannies often twins. Giving birth costs the mother condition.
